subject: Request: Meridian pilot - on-demand audit-export + tenant retention override
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Meridian pilot - on-demand audit-export + tenant retention override

Marissa / Karthik —

Quick context: Meridian Health (Sara + Tom on CC) are asking for a pilot capability we don't currently support out-of-the-box. They need the ability to trigger an on-demand export of a tenant's complete audit trail to their S3 (us-east-1) with two special requirements: 1) a tenant-scoped retention override (shorter retention TTL for pilot artifacts, ~90 days), and 2) an automated PHI redaction step before writing to external storage (they flagged HIPAA oversight).

Why it matters: Procurement has signaled that this capability is a gating item for the pilot contract. The committed ARR for the pilot + first-year expansion is ~ $600k. Legal/procurement are flexible if we can show a clear control and timeline. They also want webhook notification when the export completes and a chain-of-custody audit (who/when triggered).

Ask: can Eng/Product prioritize a scoped MVP: "audit-export-on-demand" + "tenant retention override flag" as an expedited EAP for Meridian? If we can't do full redaction, what's the minimum secure workaround we can offer (e.g., redaction via PS or temporary access to pre-redacted export)?

Attached: Meridian_MAAP_requirements.pdf (high level requirements they just sent) — sharing privately via HubSpot link as well.

I need a quick feasibility note by EOD Wednesday (20 Jan) so I can update Procurement and avoid slipping the close. If we can commit an engineering spike next week, I'll offer Meridian a paid PS block to handle redaction for the pilot.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Meridian pilot - on-demand audit-export + tenant retention override

Rafael —

Thanks for the summary. High-level feasibility notes from infra/serving perspective:
- We already have a bulk export job (daily) that can write tokenized audit events to S3; it lacks a tenant-level retention override and the on-demand API trigger.
- PHI redaction is not currently a first-class feature in the export pipeline. We can run a post-export redaction job (map/reduce style) but that adds latency and compute.
- Chain-of-custody metadata exists in the event DB (actor, timestamp) and can be included in the export.

Possible scoped approaches (fast -> slower):
1) Minimal MVP (1 week spike + config): Add on-demand trigger for existing export pipeline + a tenant retention metadata flag (does not change core retention store; writes TTL metadata into export manifest). No automatic redaction. Offer PS to perform redaction as a service for pilot.
2) Moderate (3 wk): Implement pre-export redaction hooks (configurable regex and PII detectors) and add retention override enforcement in storage lifecycle.
3) Full (6+ wk): Build retention override at serving layer with policy enforcement, integrated KMS per-tenant, and audited redaction pipeline.

Questions:
- What throughput do they expect for a single export (GBs)?
- Are we comfortable with a PS redaction interim? Legal will likely want a clear scope and liability note.

I'll do a short spike plan and estimated PRD size if you want me to take point.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Product Manager, Infra

From: Sara Mendez <sara.mendez@meridianhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: Meridian pilot - on-demand audit-export + tenant retention override

Thanks Rafael — quick clarifications from Meridian side:
- We do require PHI redaction before handing exports to external vendors/auditors. If Redwood can't do automated redaction we can accept a temporary PS redaction performed by Redwood under a DPA addendum, but it must be logged and auditable.
- Expected export size: typically 15-25GB for a 90-day window for a single care network (they have 3 networks; pilot scope = 1 network).
- Preferred destination: us-east-1 S3 (customer-owned account). We will provide temporary credentials and a bucket.
- Chain-of-custody: auditors require an appended manifest listing trigger identity, job id, timestamps, and SHA256 checksums.
- Timeline: procurement would like this capability demonstrated in a pilot environment before 15 Feb to keep legal/finance cadence.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through their PDF.

—Sara
Sara Mendez
Director, Security & Compliance, Meridian Health Systems

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sara Mendez <sara.mendez@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Meridian pilot - on-demand audit-export + tenant retention override

Marissa / Karthik —

Appreciate the options. For business context: Meridian's procurement team has framed this as a binary gating item for the pilot; slipping the demo window risks pushing the close into next quarter. I'm prepared to: 1) authorize a paid PS block to run redaction for the pilot, and 2) accept a limited-scope MVP that surfaces the manifest (with custody metadata) and an on-demand trigger writing to Meridian's S3.

If Product can commit to an eng spike next week (Jan 25) and a scoped pilot (deliverable: on-demand export with manifest + PS redaction for the pilot), I will ask Meridian to sign the pilot SOW and proceed. Otherwise we'll likely need to negotiate a longer procurement cycle.

Action I need from you by EOD Wed (20 Jan): quick thumbs on which MVP approach you can support (Minimal MVP w/ PS redaction or Moderate with built-in redaction) and an estimated lead time. I'll use that in the procurement update.

Thanks — Rafael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Mendez <sara.mendez@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Meridian pilot - on-demand audit-export + tenant retention override

Team —

Summary / decision: we can support an expedited scoped MVP with the following commitments and caveats:

What we will do (MVP - scoped):
- Engineering spike (week of Jan 25) to add an on-demand export API that triggers existing bulk export pipeline and produces a signed manifest with chain-of-custody fields (actor, job id, timestamps, SHA256).
- Tenant retention override: add TTL metadata to the export manifest and an export lifecycle config; this will not change our internal retention enforcement for production tenants during the spike.
- PS-assisted redaction: for the pilot only, Redwood PS will run a scripted redaction job on the exported objects in Meridian's S3. PS scope and liability will be captured in the pilot SOW.

Caveats / risks:
- This is not a permanent compliance-grade redaction feature. Building integrated, auditable redaction + per-tenant KMS will require the Moderate/Full tracks outlined by Karthik (3-6+ weeks).
- Storage costs for large exports will be billed to the customer per the proposal; we will include a guardrail to avoid runaway syncs.
- Legal needs to sign the DPA addendum and PS attachment before any PS redaction work occurs.

Next actions:
- Evelyn, please take point on the SOW and coordinate with Legal for the DPA addendum (target: draft by Fri Jan 22).
- Karthik, please prepare spike plan (deliverables + rough estimate) by EOD Thu Jan 21. If the spike looks clean, we will allocate a 1-sprint canary slot to validate with Meridian.
- Rafael, share the signed pilot SOW and Meridians' S3 details once Legal confirms DPA scope.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync Thu to align on scope.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product — Core Platform
Attachments: redwood-proposal-v2.docx
